title: Leroy's New BILLET Transmission & Lumberjack's BEST PASS EVER
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-51:18; 108 segments). Merch/spatula segment 7:43-12:48 and free-turbo calls 44:01-end contain no build data.

merch_turbo_sizes.fact: Daily free-turbo giveaway offered sizes 64/66, 76 and 88

transmission.model: Liberty (Liberty's Gears) billet manual, case based on Chrysler 727 architecture
transmission.notes: Mockup case (no internals) test-fit without cutting floor/tunnel; one crossmember needed clearancing. Liberty sending two complete transmissions with two different gear ratios (one serves as spare). Takes any gear offered, 'like a motorcycle transmission'; shifter lockout being made to block downshifts (e.g. 3 back to 1)
transmission.raw_caption_note: caption also mentions 'Pacifica' and 'country' as the case origin - contradictory with 727; low confidence

chassis.decision: Keep stock floor/tunnel/firewall rather than cut it out (would require new firewall, windshield, floor, pedals; safety concern with driver under engine-bay fire)

weight_tradeoff.note: weight saving forgone by keeping the floor

mid_plate.desc: mid plate to be thickened by ~1/8 in to ~1/4 in total

engine.note: new engine said to be ~100 lb lighter

driveshaft.desc: new driveshaft to be overnighted by 'Doug' (sponsor; caption 'Beef dog' unclear)

heads.desc: CNC-ported heads, new valves, new valve springs, ported exhaust ports; new head gaskets and head studs; all from LME

ecu.desc: HP Tuners; tuned by Matt Sanford (remote, from data logs)

exhaust.desc: open headers for first fire; full exhaust with adjustable volume planned

first_start.note: first fire on open headers; valvetrain quiet

giveaway.desc: C7 giveaway, 3 weeks left; $5 merch spend = 1 entry

cars.build_version: Lumberjack - fixed MAP/oil-pressure sensors, new valve covers
cars.owner_driver: Jackstand (likely driver/builder; captions refer to 'Jackson'/'jack stand'); tuning handed to 'Doctor' (Nate?)

base_vehicle.note: vehicle has a tailgate (truck); also referred to as 'CNS number one, your first build' - unclear

engine.notes: New baffled valve covers (Motion Race Works, mismatched black/gold scratch-and-dent pair), bigger baffled catch can, -10 AN breather lines replacing 3/8 fuel hose; old valve-cover gasket had melted from an exhaust leak

ignition.spark_plugs: colder heat range '11' plugs installed in cyl 7 and 5 at track; cheap ('Chinese') plug wires

dyno.note: boost exceeded MAP sensor range so boost unknown; ~100 hp gained after fixing sensors
boost turned down 10 psi vs previous; AFR on target, tune pulling 5-8% fuel; oil pressure 84 psi

passes.notes: pedaled early; launched on ~4 psi; PB previously ~9.50 (claimed)
boost raised +5 (claimed 30 psi on dome); 29.4 psi peak out the back; 7,100 rpm through traps; car stepped out; first 5-second eighth; new personal best
third attempt after further +5 boost and loosened front limiter strap; strap trapped under control arm pulled nose down, no time given

failures.cause: spark plug/wiring; fixed with fresh plugs

suspension.desc: front travel limiter strap; ~100 degrees steering angle (joke)

parts.part: Parts owed between crew for 'cow tracks'
